must_present.label: Dense spruce/pine voxel trees (trunk + canopy cubes) in this band
Snow cubes on tree canopies, not only on the ground
Cloud deck and snowfall particles above this foothill band
Elevated foothill shelf in front of the snow mountains
Placed animals in this biome (deer/fox/wolf/rabbit class), not a biome-id mention
Under-canopy forest floor cover (ferns, berries, or low shrubs between the pines)

must_not_present.label: Blizzard as the snow-forest weather (snowfall is expected; blizzard belongs on the peaks)
Jungle trees or pink blossom canopy as the snow forest
Cactus or lava in the conifer band
Palms or desert dunes as the snow forest
